notes.subject: Kristy call notes — final handwritten batch
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten sheet lists Drummond PRCA Rodeo, 406-288-3179, and says Butch / left message. Gmail history supplies the key objection: Drummond Kiwanis previously said there was not enough space close to the rodeo; even food and beverage vendors struggle for space. Preserve as a space/footprint objection rather than a cold lead.
